note: Campground, grill and bar on US-385 south of Deadwood (21372 US-385) in the pines, with ATV/OHV trails about a mile away and riding straight out from the sites. RV rows run either side of a small creek; the operator sells creek-view 50-amp sites. Cabins and tent sites too. --Claude
summary: Operator's own booking engine (SPA, read headless): 76 sites, RV from $27 dry / $39 water+electric to $61 50-amp full hookup - stored 27/61 confirmed (now manual), hookups 50/water/sewer confirmed, pull-through, booking platform operator + check-in/out. Price gate passes. Google 4.6/45. Mostly nightly (seasonal May-Sep packages are 'limited'). OHV FLAG for the reviewer: markets riding straight out from the campsite. Creek-view sites R38-R45: creekside lead.
flags: OHV (reviewer decides, not a drop by me): the operator markets the campground as an ATV base - 'ride out directly into some of the best ATV country in the country. No shuttles. No trailering. Just wake up and ride.', 'Direct ATV & OHV trail access from your campsite into the Black Hills.', 'No trailering. No driving to a staging area.', '700+ MILES OF OHV TRAILS', '1mi TO ATV TRAIL ACCESS'. Under the hard rule, 'private parks that market ATV trails starting at the campground' are out; against that it is also a general campground with a grill/bar, cabins and 50-amp sites marketed to Sturgis and Mount Rushmore visitors.

PRICE GATE: passes - cheapest RV night $27 (dry RV site R1-R3, length not shown) and $39 parallel 30-amp water/electric; summer peak $61 (50-amp full hookup). No Good Sam/member discount posted. Google Maps '385 Grill & Campground' 4.6 stars over 45 reviews, phone +1 605-641-8025. RV Life: not listed.

LONG-STAY: 2027 May-September seasonal RV packages are sold ('LIMITED SEASONAL PACKAGES', 'limited seasonal inventory'); the engine offers ~53 RV sites by the night across 12 categories, so the park is nightly in character. Five tests pass (nights sold online with posted prices; no lots sold; seasonal share limited).

WATERFRONT LEAD (no change): the operator sells '50 Amp Full Hookup RV Site (Creek View)' R38-R45 and tent sites 'along the creek' with 'Creek Access'. Esri imagery shows a small creek (a few metres wide) in an open grass strip between the two RV rows, ~10-25 m from the east row's pads with no road between. Stored 'not waterfront' could become creekside for R38-R45 if the site map ties those numbers to that row; I could not tie the numbers to the imagery (the site map is a JS canvas), so not upgraded.

RIG LENGTH: the dry ($27) sites' lengths are not shown; the operator says 'Whether you're rolling in with a 40-foot rig' and a quoted review mentions a 38-ft fifth wheel. A 23-ft rig fits the water/electric and full-hookup sites.
